communication.interpretation: Logical per-rank payload is counted once per collective, not per kernel. Kernel time includes waiting. Interval overlap is local to one trace clock; uncovered communication is not a measured critical path or causal speedup.

bucket_inventory.method: installed reducer passive bucket/parameter inventory after warmed profiled run
bucket_inventory.interpretation: Direct parameter ownership is many-to-many. No comm hook is installed or replaced. This inventory alone does not identify a timed collective or allocate its cost among member groups.
